english.title: Vehicle interference - trailer
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) interfered with a trailer, namely **(..SPECIFY TRAILER..), or anything carried in or on the same with the intention that an offence of theft of the said trailer or part of it or of anything carried in or on the said trailer or an offence under section 12(1) of the Theft Act 1968 should be committed
english.legislation: Contrary to section 9 of the Criminal Attempts Act 1981.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: See also the associated offence wording H588 which relates to interference with a motor vehicle.
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant interfered with a trailer, namely **(..SPECIFY TRAILER..), or anything carried in or on the same with the intention that an offence of theft of the said trailer or part of it or of anything carried in or on the said trailer or an offence under section 12(1) of the Theft Act 1968 should be committed.

other.penalty:
Three months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
